name: Local brain (Qwen / Llama / any GGUF)
author: Saeed
description: A language model that runs on this PC with no internet and no API cost (Qwen, Llama, Gemma... any GGUF file). Private and quick for chat; small models use tools less well than Claude. Experimental. It loads when you talk and is released when idle.

settings.label: Or use a model file already on this PC
